content:
At the forefront of Quality Higher Education and Academic Excellence
Graphic Era Hill University
Founded in 2011, Graphic Era Hill University is a private university located in Dehradun, Uttarakhand, India , with the goal of providing world class-education with a clear focus on cutting-edge technologies, professional development of students, critical thinking and quality research. The University has achieved numerous milestones in its glorious past on the basis of its academic rigor, consistently Top Performing Students and Alumni and an immensely strong and qualified teaching fraternity.
Graphic Era Hill University is based in the magnificent and serene city of Dehradun, nestled in the valley surrounded by Rajaji National Park on one end and Clement Town Cantonment on the other. The University prides itself in its University regime that warrants the holistic development of all the students part of the Graphic Era Fraternity.

33 Years Of Academic Excellence
Prof. (Dr.) Kamal Ghanshala
The Founder-President of the prestigious Graphic Era Group of Institutions is a renowned academician and edupreneur. Prof. Ghanshala still continues to take classes of every student of Computer Science that passesout of Graphic Era Group of Institutions, ensuring a high level of competence in the core subjects of Data Structures and Algorithms. His contribution in the field of research can be felt globally in USA, Canada, London, Paris, Germany, Denmark, Johannesburg, Turkey, Croatia and Thailand. Amongst many laurels, he has been conferred the ‘Uttarakhand Ratna, 2007’ for outstanding contribution to quality Technical and Higher education and the ‘Visionary Edupreneur of India Award, 2017’ by Hon’ble Former President of India, Mr. Pranab Mukherjee.

title: About Us - Graphic Era Hill University, Dehradun
content:
At the forefront of Quality Higher Education and Academic Excellence Graphic Era Hill University
Graphic Era Hill University is the culmination of the hard work of its visionary founder, Prof. (Dr.) Kamal Ghanshala, who had the dream to change the destiny of thousands of youths through quality and holistic education. Founded in 2011, GEHU (Graphic Era Hill University) is a private university located in Dehradun, Uttarakhand, India. The university is set up under Section 2(f) of the UGC Act, 1956 as the extension of the Graphic Era Educational Society, Dehradun. Graphic Era Hill University is widely known for its innovative and diligent education system which has nurtured professionals across industries and sectors in India and beyond . The university is known for its high-quality education and state-of-the-art facilities.
Nestled in the central part of the scenic and modern city of Dehradun, bordered by Rajaji National Park and the Clement Town Cantonment on either sides, the University Campus is a sight to behold. The serene and picturesque campus with the energy of the students studying and staying at the campus is almost infectious and provides an unforgettable experience for all the students who’re a part of the Graphic Era fraternity. The Campus is well equipped with facilities of all kinds, including but not limited to Sports, World Class Accommodation for its students, Gymnasiums, Recreational Areas, State of the Art Libraries and Computer Centres, High Speed Wi-Fi Enabled Campus, State of the Art Lecture Theatres equipped with Smart Boards, Auditoriums (Both Indoor and Outdoor), Multiple Cafeterias and Food Trucks and so much more.
Graphic Era Hill University offers undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs in various fields such as engineering, law, management, computer applications, humanities, applied sciences, animation, fashion designing, journalism, and mass communication, Agriculture. The university has a diverse student population from various parts of the country and abroad, which adds to the rich cultural experience.
One of the key strengths of Graphic Era Hill University is its faculty. The university has a team of highly qualified and experienced faculty members who are experts in their respective fields. The faculty members are passionate about teaching and are committed to providing a holistic learning experience to the students. The university also invites guest lecturers from reputed institutions and industry experts to give the students exposure to real-world scenarios.
The university has a vast and modern campus that provides students with a conducive learning environment. The campus is equipped with modern infrastructure, including state-of-the-art classrooms, well-equipped laboratories, libraries, sports facilities, and hostel accommodation. The university also has a well-stocked library with a vast collection of books, journals, and e-resources to support research and learning.
The University has an abiding commitment to create excellent education opportunities for the youth hailing from the hills of Uttarakhand State, at affordable cost. Therefore 25% domicile concession in the fee is also offered to the local students of Uttarakhand. Furthermore, additional discounts are also provided by the university to deserving candidates.
At Graphic Era Hill University, we believe in providing students with a holistic learning experience. The university offers a range of co-curricular and extracurricular activities such as sports, cultural events, and clubs, which help in the overall development of the students. The university also encourages students to participate in community service and social initiatives, which helps them to become responsible and socially aware citizens.
In addition, Graphic Era Hill University has a robust placement cell that helps students to secure internships and job opportunities. The placement cell has tie-ups with various reputed companies across different sectors, and it provides students with the necessary training and guidance to help them succeed in their careers.
Graphic Era Hill University is an excellent institution that provides students with a world-class education and a holistic learning experience. The university has a diverse student population, highly qualified faculty, modern infrastructure, and a range of co-curricular activities, making it an ideal choice for students who are looking for a comprehensive education.

Celebrating 30 Years of Brand Graphic Era
Here’s a look at the important milestones in the glorious history of Graphic Era
Our Mission
The mission of Graphic Era Hill University is to promote learning in true spirit. The University offers knowledge and skills needed to succeed as professionals, and the values and sensitivity needed to be responsible citizens of the world.
Our Vision
We visualize Graphic Era Hill University as an internationally recognized, inquiry-driven, ethically engaged university with a diverse community, whose members work collaboratively, for the positive transformation of the world by pioneering teaching, research, and social awareness.

title: Admission 2026, Dehradun - Graphic Era Hill University
content:
Take your First Step towards success!
Choosing the right University is an important decision for any student, for the professional success one aspires for in their lives, depends on this very decision. Graphic Era offers its prospective students, more than 85 UG, PG and Doctoral Programmes to choose from, spread across various domains such as Engineering, Computer Application, Management, Commerce, Life Sciences, Food Technology, Hospitality, Paramedical, Humanities and Social Sciences and more.
The application process at Graphic Era is strictly based on the Merit of the qualifying examination with the entire Admission Process available for completion online. *NOTE: Graphic Era doesn’t outsource any of its admission activities. Please beware of imposters posing to represent Graphic Era. For any and all clarifications, please write to us at enquiry@gehu.ac.in or call us on our Toll Free: 1800 890 6027
Get Started!
Choose the course of your choice
Top Placements
Consistently High Placements at Top MNCs like Amazon, Adobe, Microsoft and Google
Merit Based Scholarships
Merit Based Scholarships in all courses for the entire duration of the course
Additional Scholarships
10% Additional Scholarship for Female Candidates and 5% Fee Concession for Wards of Defence Personnel
Accreditations and Rankings
Graphic Era enjoys Top-Tier Rankings and Accreditations, some of which are exclusive (in the region)
The Application Process:
Choose your Course of Interest
This is the most important step of your application process, since there are more than 85 Programs to choose from at UG, PG and PhD Level. Considering your core skills, aptitude and interest are key factors before arriving at the right choice.
Start your Online Application
Although this step can be performed while you visit our campus or one of our Pan India admission centres, we advise that you start your application online. This ensures timely updates and a hassle free paperless admission process.
Application can be started by clicking here
Fill your form and upload documents
The Online application process allows you to fill up forms on multiple levels and submitting your qualifying documents
Review your application and Submit
Carefully review your application and your credentials and then submit the application form
Complete Application Fee Payment
Once your form is successfully submitted, complete the application fee payment (₹ 1500 for all courses)
Finalize Admission by Paying the Course Fee
The final course fee can be paid once Step 5 is completed by choosing the appropriate payment mode. The final/provisional allotment letter will be provided digitally along with other course commencement information.

University Grants Commission  
Notification 
on 
 
 
 
 
 
December, 2016 
Remittance and Refund of Fees and Other Student-centric 
Issues 
1.  Introduction: 
One of the fundamentals of the Indian higher education system, even after the 
significant evolution of private sector in the domain, has remained its 
commitment to provide education without profit. The rationale behind this 
policy paradigm has been to protect the rights and entitlements of students 
whose financial conditions often pose a roadblock to their desire for quality 
higher education. For a country like India, it is but natural to promote “not-for-
profit” paradigm in view of low per capita income and high poverty index. It has 
to be acknowledged that this apparently idealistic principle has worked to an 
appreciable extent in India. However, the considerable number of complaints, 
grievances, court cases and other references received by UGC on various 
coercive and shady dealings carried out by HEIs reflect that profiteering 
motivations still drive the operation of quite a few institutions in India. The 
reason behind the proliferation of such malpractices can be many, including 
absence of an effective and robust policy regime. However, what is most 
disturbing about the dismal scenario is that students are at the receiving end of 
this malaise. The Commission has earlier notified University Grants 
Commission (Grievance Redressal) Regulations, 2012 on redressal of 
multifarious grievances of students. But given the sheer volume of the 
complaints regarding non-refund of fees and retention of original certificates by

--- Page 3 ---
2 | P a g e 
 
HEIs and other related issues, the Commission has felt the need to notify 
elaborate instructions so as to curb such malpractices. Considering the 
seriousness of the issue, the UGC has decided to issue appropriate instructions 
in the form of this notification to all universities and other higher educational 
institutions under the purview of UGC. 
2.  Objective: 
To prohibit coercive and profiteering institutional practices in the matters 
related to verification of certificates and testimonials at the time of admission, 
remittance of fees and refund thereof in case of cancellation of admission and 
other such student-centric issues. 
In exercise of powers conferred by Section 12 (d) read with Section 12(j) of the 
UGC Act, 1956, the UGC issues this notification for adoption of standard 
operating procedures in the matters related to verification of certificates and 
testimonials at the time of admission, remittance of fees and refund thereof in 
case of cancellation of admission and other such student-centric issues with an 
aim to curb coercive and profiteering institutional practices that directly and 
indirectly constrain the fundamental rights of students to explore multiple 
opportunities and choices in terms of their academic career.   
3. Application and Enforcement 
1.1. The instructions contained in this notification shall be in supersession to its 
earlier Public Notice dated 23.04.2007. It shall be applicable to Undergraduate, 
Postgraduate and Research Programs run by all statutory universities 
recognized by UGC under Section 2 (f) of UGC Act, together with all colleges 
under their affiliating domain and institutions declared as deemed to be 
universities under Section 3 of the UGC Act. 
1.2 The instructions contained in this notification shall come into force with 
immediate effect and shall have regulatory force on extant as well as future 
grievances over issues and matters covered herein. 
1.3 Universities shall amend their relevant statutes, rules, regulations etc. and 
bring them in line with the provisions contained herein.

--- Page 4 ---
3 | P a g e 
 
4. Specific Instructions and Mandatory Actions for HEIs: 
The Commission herewith lays down specific instructions and consequent 
mandatory actions on the issues related to (1) verification and non-retention of 
students’ academic and personal certificates and testimonials, (2) remittance of 
fees by students and refund thereof by the institution concerned in the event of 
the cancellation of admission by the student and (3) an effective grievance 
redressal mechanism to be installed by the affiliating university for quick and 
effective resolution of grievances in this regard; 
4.1.1 No institution of higher education shall insist upon a student to submit the 
original academic and personal certificates and testimonials like mark-sheets, 
school leaving certificates and other such documents at the time of submitting 
admission form. 
4.1 Verification and Non-retention of Students’ Academic and Personal 
testimonials  
4.1.2 In line with instructions issued by Ministry of Personnel, Public 
Grievances & Pension, Department of Administrative Reforms, PG & Pension, 
the Commission has already written to HEIs about allowing self-attestation of 
documents such as mark-sheets, birth certificate etc. by the applicant where 
there is a system of verification of the original certificates and testimonials at 
any stage before the finalization of the process of admission. 
4.1.3 HEIs shall physically verify the originals at the time of admission of the 
student in his/her presence and return them immediately after satisfying 
themselves about their authenticity and veracity, keeping the attested copies for 
their record. 
4.1.4 The self-attested testimonials of students shall be held valid and authentic 
by institution concerned and/or the affiliating university for all purposes and 
administrative requirements and should there be a need for physical 
verification at any time during the course of program of study, such verification 
shall be undertaken in the presence of the student and certificates and 
testimonials thus verified shall be returned immediately to the student.

--- Page 5 ---
4 | P a g e 
 
4.1.5 Taking the certificates and testimonials into institutional custody under 
any circumstances or pretexts is strictly prohibited for it is a coercive tactic 
which can be misused for blackmailing students who wish to withdraw 
admission from the institute for better prospects or other compulsions. 
4.1.5 In case of any suspicion over the authenticity or genuineness of the 
testimonials, the reference may be made to the university or the Board which 
issued certificates to the student and the admission be subjected to the 
authentication, but original certificates shall not be retained under any 
circumstances 
4.2.1 No HEI shall make it mandatory for applicants to purchase the 
institutional prospectus any time during the course of the program of study. 
Purchasing prospectus shall be the personal choice of the student and he/she 
has all rights to decide against it in case he/she wishes to access the information 
from institutional website. As laid down in the Right to Information Act, 2005, 
and reiterated in the UGC Guidelines on Students’ Entitlement, all HEIs shall 
disclose on their website and prospectus information like the status of the 
institution, its affiliation, accreditation rating, physical assets and amenities, 
course-wise sanctioned intake of students, details of faculty, membership of 
governing 
bodies 
and 
minutes 
of 
the 
meetings 
of 
bodies 
like 
Academic/Executive council, sources of income and the financial situation and 
any other information about its functioning necessary for a student to make a 
fully informed choice.  
4.2 Remittance and Refund of Fees  
4.2.2 HEIs shall charge fees in advance only for the semester/year in which a 
student is to engage in academic activities. Collecting advance fees for entire 
program of study or for more than one semester/year in which a student is 
enrolled is strictly prohibited as it restricts the student from exercising other 
options of enrolment elsewhere. This enabling provision is in line with the UGC 
guidelines on Choice-Based Credit System (CBCS) and Model Curricula which 
are geared towards promoting a student’s inter-institutional mobility.

--- Page 6 ---
5 | P a g e

he/she is enrolled, the institution concerned shall follow the following four-tier 
system for the refund of fees remitted by the student.

Committee” (GRC) mandated by UGC (Grievance Redressal) Regulations 2012

5.1 Any act of retention of original certificate or non-refund of fee by any college

title: Scholarships - Graphic Era Hill University, Dehradun
content:
The University introduces handsome scholarships Year on Year, which often have proven to be the trend setters for private Universities in India. This document provides clarity on the Types of Scholarships and Waivers that students have the possibility of availing depending on their candidatures
Types of Scholarships
Academic Scholarship
The Fee Structure at Graphic Era, clearly mentions the Academic Scholarships provided in all courses defined in various categories based on the merit of the candidate obtained in the qualifying examination considered for admission into that specific course.
The Academic Scholarships provided in the Fee Structure has been defined for the entire course duration. The Scholarship bracket availed by the candidate at the time of the admission is frozen for the entire duration of the course. There is no change in the scholarship amount during the course, however the candidate will have to score a minimum aggregate of 7 SGPA, in order for the scholarship to applied in each semester. For candidates who fail to score 7 SGPA or above in any of the semesters, the scholarship will not be applicable for that particular semester. If the candidate is able to score 7 SGPA or above in the subsequent semester(s), the scholarship will be reinstated. In addition to the aforementioned 7 SGPA clause, the same terms are applicable on the student obtaining a backlog (failing to pass a subject) in a semester. If the student scores 7 SGPA or above but has still scored a backlog in a subject, the scholarship for that semester will be discontinued.
The fee structure clearly mentions the amount of the Academic Scholarship available to candidates or the entire course duration. This amount remains fixed for the entire course duration.
There are a number of other scholarships/concessions that the candidates might be eligible for – please do not confuse this with the Academic Scholarship – the amounts for this are mentioned clearly under the head “Academic Scholarship” in the Fee Structures corresponding to all courses.
Fee Concession For Female Candidates (10% On Net Tuition Fee)
An integral part of our Scholarship structure is the vision to empower females in various disciplines across the country, and as a part of this effort, Graphic Era has been running a special scholarship scheme for all Female Candidates in the University
An additional 10% Scholarship is provided to all female candidates (across all courses) on the Net Tuition Fee. This Scholarship is termed additional, as it will be applicable to candidates regardless of whether they are availing Academic Scholarship or not.
Fee Concession For Wards Of Defence Personnel (5% On Net Tuition Fee)
Graphic Era has a rich legacy of respecting the service of the Personnel of the brave defence forces of India, and as a no questions asked benefit being passed on to the community, the University has a blanket Fee Concession of 5% on the Net Tuition Fee for all candidates who are wards of Defence Personnel.
This category covers Current and Ex-Servicemen from the Indian Armed Forces (Indian Army, Indian Air Force, Indian Navy and all Paramilitary Forces) across all levels.
The candidate will be required to provide proof of employment for their parent(s) in the categories mentioned above.
Loyalty Concession: 10% (On Net Tuition Fee)
Graphic Era values it’s Alumni, and wishes to assist them in attaining Higher Education to the extent that they aspire to. In order to ease out the process of attaining degrees higher than graduation, the University provides a Loyalty Concession of 10% on the Net Tuition Fee for all candidates who have attained a UG Degree from any of the institutions falling under the purview of Graphic Era Group of Institutions.
The difference between Year of Passing out and the Year of enrolling in a PG Course bear no importance in this concession. Any and every one falling into the aforementioned criterion will be provided this benefit.
Sibling Concession: (7.5% - Current Student and 5% - Alumni on Net Tuition Fee)
The University, its students and its Alumni are one big family and with this clear understanding, we aspire to provide financial assistance to candidates who are immediate siblings of a current student of Graphic Era or an Alumni of any of the institutions under Graphic Era Group of Institutions.
There are two sub-categories of concessions in this category:
Current Student: Immediate Siblings of a student who is currently a student of Graphic Era will be eligible for a Fee Concession of 7.5% on the Net Tuition Fee.
Alumni: Immediate Siblings of a student who is an Alumni of Graphic Era, will be eligible for a Fee Concession of 5% on the Net Tuition Fee.
Important Conditions: 1. The concession is applicable only for immediate siblings and not for cousins or any other distant sibling relation. 2. If two candidates (real siblings) are seeking admission at the same time, with no sibling already studying at Graphic Era or passed out from Graphic Era, only one of the two students will be eligible for the Sibling Concession (7.5%) – which of the two candidates wishes to receive the Concession is up to the candidate and their family. 3. If the status of the a current student of Graphic Era, who’s sibling has just taken admission at the University, changes from Current Student to Alumni, during the course of the younger sibling – the concession will be revised from 7.5% to 5% as soon as the elder sibling passes out of the University
Download Full Scholarship Policy Graphic Era University 2023 Policy
Policy For The Application Of The Scholarships/concessions
Since there are a number of scholarships that a candidate may be eligible for, there is a formal rule that defines the maximum number of scholarships a candidate may avail. The rule is defined as below, along with a use case that clarifies all scenarios:
Mandatory Scholarship (For Candidates eligible as per the different criterions defined in the corresponding section) –
Academic Scholarship
All other scholarships are additional scholarships that are added on top of the Academic Scholarship. As a formal rule, a maximum of 3 Scholarships/Concessions can be availed by a candidate in addition to the Academic Scholarship (Academic Scholarship + 3 Additional Scholarships/Concessions). These scholarships are applied in descending order, in order to provide the maximum benefit to the candidate.
Use Case for clear understanding:
Candidate A is seeking admission at Graphic Era – He is eligible for Academic Scholarship, Female Candidate Scholarship, Ward of Defence Personnel, Loyalty Concession and Sibling Concession (7.5%). The order of the Scholarship/Concession granted will be as below:
Academic Scholarship → Female Candidate (10%) → Loyalty Concession (10%) → Sibling Concession (7.5%)
So, as per the rule – Academic Scholarship + 3 – the aforementioned discounts were provided – Defence Scholarship wasn’t included as it carries a lower value (5%) as compared to the other concessions that the candidate was eligible for, and since there are only a maximum of 3 Scholarships that can be applied on top of the Academic Scholarship, the aforementioned scenario was the one that provided the highest concession possible.
Important Note:
An additional 5% Concession on Net Tuition Fee is applicable for candidates who choose to pay their Course Fees in Annual Mode i.e. Depositing their Course Fee for an entire year together. This concession is only applicable to yearly payment mode and candidates paying their fees in half-yearly mode will not be provided any concession.
It is important to note that this concession is applied after all of the above scholarships have been calculated – this is not a part of the Mandatory Scholarships + 3 rule.
All scholarships are provided on the condition of the candidates providing valid documents concerning the criterion. Failure to provide the same will result in immediate cancellation of the scholarship allotted, and in cases of fake documentation provided – the candidate will be liable to have his/her admission cancelled, in addition to recovery of dues and legal proceedings that may follow.
Admissions Open 2026
The application process at Graphic Era is strictly based on the Merit of the qualifying examination with the entire Admission Process available for completion online

title: Best Engineering Colleges in Dehradun | Computer Science and Engineering
content:
If you are passionate about Computer Science and Engineering and want to join a progressive community, the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at Graphic Era Hill University invites you to be a part of it.
The Department of Computer Science and Engineering at Graphic Era Hill University welcomes you. This department has a long-standing history of providing exceptional educational, research, internship, and career opportunities to its students. The department has produced successful alumni who have become leaders in various world-class multi-national organizations.
The department boasts a highly qualified faculty, including skilled industry experts who have received education from globally recognized universities and have achieved success in and researched diverse fields like Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Cybersecurity, Cloud Computing, Blockchain, and Big Data Analytics. The undergraduate and postgraduate programs in Computer Science and Engineering offered by the department aim to provide students with practical knowledge and allow them to specialize in their areas of interest. The curriculum is frequently updated to keep up with the latest industry trends and covers a wide range of topics, and practical approaches such as laboratory experience, workshops, seminars, webinars, and guest lectures are incorporated into the courses.
The library is well-equipped with the latest books, journals, and research papers that students may need in their educational, research, or career pursuits.
The department encourages student participation in various activities, competitions, conferences, and workshops, as well as research projects. The department provides a state-of-the-art infrastructure, equipped with the latest hardware and software. A few examples are the CISCO Networking Academy launched in collaboration with CISCO, the Ubuntu Lab, the IoT lab, and MAC Computer Center.
By collaborating with various industry giants like Wipro, Adobe, CISCO, and Sapient Razorfish the department ensures that its students are well-placed in various multinationals. The department takes pride in the achievements of its alumni and provides opportunities for current students to interact with them and gain career guidance.
The department is dedicated to providing its students with a holistic education that goes beyond technical knowledge. The department recognizes the importance of developing well-rounded individuals who possess not only technical skills but also critical thinking, creativity, and communication skills. To achieve this, the department offers various extracurricular activities and events that help students hone their leadership, teamwork, and communication skills. The department also encourages students to participate in community service and outreach programs, which provide opportunities for them to apply their technical skills to solve real-world problems and make a positive impact on society. Through these initiatives, the department aims to produce graduates who are not only technically proficient but also socially responsible and ethical individuals.

title: Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE ) | GEHU, Dehradun
content:
If you’re passionate about engineering, innovation, and cutting-edge technology, the Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) at Graphic Era Hill University is the ideal place to begin your journey.
Our department is committed to excellence in education, research, and innovation in the field of Electronics and Communication Engineering. We aim to nurture industry-ready engineers who can address real-world challenges with confidence and creativity—both in India and across the globe.
To support this vision, the department offers state-of-the-art infrastructure, including advanced laboratories such as the INTEL Lab, Cadence Lab, Wireless Sensor Network Lab, Texas Instrumentation Lab, and the Polymer Sensors & Actuators Lab. These labs are designed to complement the curriculum and provide students with a strong foundation in practical and research-oriented learning. In addition to physical infrastructure, students also benefit from access to premium industry-standard software tools such as MathWorks Suite, Xilinx, Genesys, OrCAD Circuit Design & PCB Tools, and the Cadence University Bundle. This combination of hands-on experience and technological exposure empowers students to develop skills that are directly applicable in professional environments.
Our department also emphasizes research, innovation, and interdisciplinary collaboration, encouraging students to participate in projects, internships, and technical events that build critical thinking and problem-solving capabilities. Faculty members play an active role in mentoring students for national and international competitions, publishing research, and pursuing innovations with real-world impact. We also maintain strong industry linkages to ensure seamless transition from academics to careers through guest lectures, industrial visits, and placement training. Over the years, our alumni have built successful careers in top organizations across sectors like electronics, telecommunications, embedded systems, VLSI design, and IoT, both in India and globally. Their success stands as a testament to the quality education and holistic development provided by the department, making it a distinguished choice for anyone aspiring to excel in the field of Electronics and Communication Engineering.

title: Department of Mechanical Engineering - GEHU, Dehradun
content:
If you are passionate about Mechanical Engineering and want to be part of an inventive and progressive community, the Department of Mechanical Engineering at Graphic Era Hill University cordially invites you.
The Department of Mechanical Engineering at Graphic Era Hill University warmly welcomes you. The department has a long-standing history of providing exceptional educational and research opportunities to its students. Many of its alumni have become successful mechanical engineers, researchers, and leaders in various national and international organizations.
The department boasts well-qualified faculty members and industry experts who have received education from renowned universities across the world. They have achievements in diverse fields, including robotics, manufacturing engineering, thermal engineering, materials science, and more. Additionally, they have received several national and international awards and serve on the editorial boards/reviewers of numerous esteemed journals in the field.
The department offers undergraduate and postgraduate programs in Mechanical Engineering that aim to provide students with practical knowledge. Students can specialize in their areas of interest by choosing from a wide range of electives. The curriculum covers topics like Manufacturing Technology, Robotics, Thermal Engineering, Materials Science, CAD/CAM, Mechatronics, and Fluid Mechanics. The courses include laboratory experience, workshops, conferences, and guest lectures, all designed with a practical approach in mind.
The department encourages students to participate in various activities, competitions, conferences, and workshops, and engage in research projects. It has partnered with reputable organizations in the field and organizes site visits to provide students with the best possible training. The department provides state-of-the-art facilities, including labs equipped with specialized software such as ANSYS, MATLAB, and SolidWorks, widely used in mechanical engineering. The library also features various books, journals, and research papers for students to access and utilize.
The department takes pride in the achievements of its alumni and believes that their network is a valuable asset for current students. To leverage this network, the department frequently organizes alumni talks where the accomplished alumni share their experiences and provide career guidance to the students.
In addition to academic and research excellence, the Department emphasizes the importance of soft skills development in its students. The department provides opportunities for students to enhance their communication, leadership, and teamwork skills through various extracurricular activities and events. Students can participate in clubs and societies like the Robotics Club, the Society of Automotive Engineers, and the Entrepreneurship Club, where they can interact with like-minded peers and develop their skills beyond the classroom. The department arranges guest lectures and workshops by industry experts to help students gain insight into the practical aspects of the field and equip them with the skills necessary for a successful career.

title: Agriculture Colleges in Dehradun | Dehradun Agriculture University
content:
The School of Agriculture at Graphic Era Hill University, Dehradun is an excellent resource for those interested in agriculture, food, and natural resources. It prepares one for a successful career in Agribusiness and Sustainable Agriculture.
The school offers various undergraduate and postgraduate degree programs. B.Sc. (Hons.) in Agriculture, MSc in Horticulture (Vegetable Sciences), M.Sc. in Agronomy, and M.Sc. in Genetics And Plant Breeding are some of the programs that the school offers. In addition to academic programs, the School also conducts research on topics such as crop production, livestock management, soil science, and environmental sustainability.
The School hosts various activities that include conducting workshops and conferences to promote sustainable agriculture and natural resource management. It boasts an exceptional faculty that is a source of pride for the institution. The faculty’s collective knowledge and expertise span various subjects. This diversity of expertise allows the School to offer a comprehensive education to its students, preparing them to tackle the present challenges. They are dedicated to sharing their knowledge with students through engaging lectures, practical demonstrations, and innovative research projects. The staff brings a wealth of experience to the classroom, widening the proficiency of students.
The infrastructure is a testament to the institution’s commitment to providing students with an exceptional learning experience. The School is equipped with state-of-the-art facilities that enable learning, research, and innovation in the field of agriculture. The  has three farm sites with a specific area provided to the respective domain for practical training of students regarding various agricultural operations such as land preparation, plant protection measures, sowing methods, cultivation, harvesting, etc. These are:
Banjarawala farm: It is a 22.5-hectare large farm area with designated Practical Crop Production and student trial sites.
Demonstration cum training farm: A 2.75 ha area specially designed for demonstration of an integrated farming system with hi-tech hydroponic-based poly houses, naturally ventilated poly houses, shade net houses, mushroom farming, floriculture, fish farming, etc.
Ganeshpur farm: A large-scale vegetable, crop, and fodder cultivation farm which is 28 hectares large and comprises of livestock system (250 cows, goats, poultry, etc), orchard, and plantation areas, etc.
Moreover, the School’s dairy unit ‘Kamdhenu Dairy’ with the capacity to cater to 200 cows is available to conduct practical and hands-on training. The milk (800-1000 litres) in dairy is supplied to hostels and utilised to make dairy products (paneer, curd, buttermilk etc.). The University also has an instructional bee-keeping unit for student training and practicals.  Apart from honey production, the bees also play a vital role in the pollination of numerous fruits and vegetables, thus, contributing to the enhancement of yield.
Moreover, the university plans to establish a 100-acre Agriculture campus to conduct groundbreaking research, enabling them to develop innovative and sustainable agricultural practices. This exposure will offer students the opportunity to apply their theoretical knowledge to real-world scenarios, preparing them to become leaders in the field of agriculture.
The School of Agriculture takes pride in its successful alumni who have made a significant impact in the field of agriculture. Graduates have careers in various areas of agriculture, including research, entrepreneurship, and policymaking. Many of them have also contributed to the development of sustainable and eco-friendly practices in agriculture, promoting responsible and ethical farming practices. Their dedication and hard work have earned them recognition and accolades from the industry.
As the world population continues to grow, the demand for food will increase, and sustainable agriculture practices will be more critical than ever before. The land for research, experimentation, and practical training, coupled with its outreach initiatives to the community, demonstrates the School’s unwavering dedication to advancing the agriculture industry and supporting its future leaders. The School of Agriculture at Graphic Era Hill University is at the forefront of developing these practices, making it an essential program for students who want to make a meaningful contribution to society.
Mandate
The mandate of this programme is to create human resource capacity of well-trained professionals in agriculture with required knowledge in applied and agriculture sciences, and practical skills for sustainable agricultural production systems needed to meet the food security and safety needs of growing global population in the 21 st century.
Specific Objectives of the Programme
To develop competent human resource in agriculture by providing quality education in agricultural and allied sciences.
To equip the students with relevant practical skills through effective curricula delivery to meet the needs of the stakeholders in academia and industry.
To develop abilities to practice and propagate various farming systems, crop diversification and sustainable agriculture practices

Scholarship Policy 
 
 
Graphic Era Hill University has been at the forefront of efforts at a national level to ensure 
accessibility of high-quality higher education for all meritorious candidates. The University 
introduces handsome scholarships Year on Year, which often have proven to be the trend setters for 
private Universities in India. This document provides clarity on the Types of Scholarships and 
Waivers that students have the possibility of availing depending on their candidatures. 
 
 
ACADEMIC SCHOLARSHIP 
 
• 
The Fee Structure at Graphic Era Hill University, clearly mentions the Academic Scholarships 
provided in all courses defined in various categories based on the merit of the candidate 
obtained in the qualifying examination considered for admission into that specific course. 
• 
The Academic Scholarships provided in the Fee Structure has been defined for the entire 
course duration. The Scholarship bracket availed by the candidate at the time of the 
admission is frozen for the entire duration of the course. There is no change in the 
scholarship amount during the course, however the candidate will have to score a minimum 
aggregate of 7 SGPA, in order for the scholarship to applied in each semester. For candidates 
who fail to score 7 SGPA or above in any of the semesters, the scholarship will not be 
applicable for that particular semester. If the candidate is able to score 7 SGPA or above in 
the subsequent semester(s), the scholarship will be reinstated. In addition to the 
aforementioned 7 SGPA clause, the same terms are applicable on the student obtaining a 
backlog (failing to pass a subject) in a semester. If the student scores 7 SGPA or above but 
has still scored a backlog in a subject, the scholarship for that semester will be discontinued. 
• 
The fee structure clearly mentions the amount of the Academic Scholarship available to 
candidates or the entire course duration. This amount remains fixed for the entire course 
duration. 
• 
There are a number of other scholarships/concessions that the candidates might be eligible 
for – please do not confuse this with the Academic Scholarship – the amounts for this are 
mentioned clearly under the head “Academic Scholarship” in the Fee Structures 
corresponding to all courses.

--- Page 2 ---
FEE CONCESSION FOR FEMALE CANDIDATES (10% On Net Tuition Fee) 
 
 
An integral part of our Scholarship structure is the vision to empower females in various disciplines 
across the country, and as a part of this effort, Graphic Era has been running a special scholarship 
scheme for all Female Candidates in the University. 
 
 
An additional 10% Scholarship is provided to all female candidates (across all courses) on the Net 
Tuition Fee. This Scholarship is termed additional, as it will be applicable to candidates regardless 
of whether they are availing Academic Scholarship or not. 
 
 
FEE CONCESSION FOR WARDS OF DEFENCE PERSONNEL (5% on NET TUITION FEE) 
 
Graphic Era Hill University has a rich legacy of respecting the service of the Personnel of the brave 
defence forces of India, and as a no questions asked benefit being passed on to the community, the 
University has a blanket Fee Concession of 5% on the Net Tuition Fee for all candidates who are 
wards of Defence Personnel. 
 
This category covers Current and Ex-Servicemen from the Indian Armed Forces (Indian Army, Indian 
Air Force, Indian Navy and all Paramilitary Forces) across all levels. 
 
The candidate will be required to provide proof of employment for their parent(s) in the categories 
mentioned above. 
 
 
Loyalty Concession: 10% (On Net Tuition Fee) 
Graphic Era Hill University values it’s Alumni, and wishes to assist them in attaining Higher Education 
to the extent that they aspire to. In order to ease out the process of attaining degrees higher than 
graduation, the University provides a Loyalty Concession of 10% on the Net Tuition Fee for all 
candidates who have attained a UG Degree from any of the institutions falling under the purview of 
Graphic Era Group of Institutions. 
The difference between Year of Passing out and the Year of enrolling in a PG Course bear no 
importance in this concession. Any and every one falling into the aforementioned criterion will be 
provided this benefit.

--- Page 3 ---
Sibling Concession: (7.5% - Current Student and 5% - Alumni on Net Tuition Fee) 
 
The University, its students and its Alumni are one big family and with this clear understanding, we 
aspire to provide financial assistance to candidates who are immediate siblings of a current student 
of Graphic Era or an Alumni of any of the institutions under Graphic Era Group of Institutions. 
There are two sub-categories of concessions in this category: 
• 
Current Student: Immediate Siblings of a student who is currently a student of Graphic Era 
will be eligible for a Fee Concession of 7.5% on the Net Tuition Fee. 
• 
Alumni: Immediate Siblings of a student who is an Alumni of Graphic Era, will be eligible for a 
Fee Concession of 5% on the Net Tuition Fee. 
• 
IMPORTANT CONDITIONS: 
o The concession is applicable only for immediate siblings and not for cousins or any other 
distant sibling relation.  
o If two candidates (real siblings) are seeking admission at the same time, with no sibling 
already studying at Graphic Era or passed out from Graphic Era, only one of the two 
students will be eligible for the Sibling Concession (7.5%) – which of the two candidates 
wishes to receive the Concession is up to the candidate and their family.  
o If the status of the a current student of Graphic Era, who’s sibling has just taken 
admission at the University, changes from Current Student to Alumni, during the course 
of the younger sibling – the concession will be revised from 7.5% to 5% as soon as the 
elder sibling passes out of the University 
 
 
POLICY FOR THE APPLICATION OF THE SCHOLARSHIPS/CONCESSIONS 
 
Since there are a number of scholarships that a candidate may be eligible for, there is a formal rule 
that defines the maximum number of scholarships a candidate may avail. The rule is defined as 
below, along with a use case that clarifies all scenarios: 
 
Mandatory Scholarship (For Candidates eligible as per the different criterions defined in the 
corresponding section) – 
 
ACADEMIC SCHOLARSHIP: 
 
All other scholarships are additional scholarships that are added on top of the Academic Scholarship. 
As a formal rule, a maximum of 3 Scholarships/Concessions can be availed by a candidate in addition 
to the Academic Scholarship (Academic Scholarship + 3 Additional Scholarships/Concessions). These 
scholarships are applied in descending order, in order to provide the maximum benefit to the 
candidate. 
 
USE CASE FOR CLEAR UNDERSTANDING: 
 
Candidate A is seeking admission at Graphic Era – He is eligible for Academic Scholarship, Female 
Candidate Scholarship, Ward of Defence Personnel, Loyalty Concession and Sibling Concession 
(7.5%). The order of the Scholarship/Concession granted will be as below: 
 
Academic Scholarship → Female Candidate (10%) → Loyalty Concession (10%) → Sibling Concession 
(7.5%)

--- Page 4 ---
So, as per the rule – Academic Scholarship + 3 – the aforementioned discounts were provided – 
Defence Scholarship wasn’t included as it carries a lower value (5%) as compared to the other 
concessions that the candidate was eligible for, and since there are only a maximum of 3 
Scholarships that can be applied on top of the Academic Scholarship, the aforementioned scenario 
was the one that provided the highest concession possible. 
 
 
IMPORTANT NOTE: 
 
An additional 5% Concession on Net Tuition Fee is applicable for candidates who choose to pay their 
Course Fees in Annual Mode i.e. Depositing their Course Fee for an entire year together. This 
concession is only applicable to yearly payment mode and candidates paying their fees in half-yearly 
mode will not be provided any concession. 
 
It is important to note that this concession is applied after all of the above scholarships have been 
calculated – this is not a part of the Mandatory Scholarships + 3 rule. 
 
All scholarships are provided on the condition of the candidates providing valid documents 
concerning the criterion. Failure to provide the same will result in immediate cancellation of the 
scholarship allotted, and in cases of fake documentation provided – the candidate will be liable to 
have his/her admission cancelled, in addition to recovery of dues and legal proceedings that may 
follow. 
 
 
For any queries regarding the Fee Structure/Scholarship/Admissions in any of the courses, please 
reach out to our counsellors at 18008906027 or drop a query at https://gehu.ac.in/

title: Anti Ragging - Graphic Era Hill University, Dehradun
content:
Graphic Era Hill University is absolutely ragging free university, Ragging in any form is strictly prohibited within the premises of Graphic Era Hill University.
Any instance of ragging would attract severe punishment of cancellation of admission, suspension, rustication or expulsion from the Institute /Hostel.
Apart from the institute-level punishment, there will be strong police and legal action. Ragging is a cognizable offence under the law of the land, and the Supreme Court has ruled that the punishment to be meted out has to be exemplary and harsh to act as a deterrent. According to relevant sections of the Indian Penal Code (IPC), those found guilty for a ragging related offence can be punished with imprisonment or fine or both. The quantum of punishment varies with the gravity of the crime. For example, Section 323, which deals with the cases of voluntarily causing hurt can lead to imprisonment up to one year or fine or both; Section 306, which deals with abetment to suicide, specifies the punishment to be imprisonment up to ten years with or without fine. Some other relevant sections of IPC in this context include Section 341 (wrongful restraint), Section 506 (criminal intimidation), Section 302 (murder), Section 307 (attempt to murder), etc.

title: M.Sc. in Animation & Multimedia - Graphic Era Hill University, Dehradun
content:
M.Sc. Animation & Multimedia equips students with advanced skills in animation and game development, empowering them to create captivating visuals, interactive experiences, and pursue exciting careers in the dynamic world of animation and gaming.
The M.Sc. Animation & Multimedia program at Graphic Era Hill University is a postgraduate program designed to provide students with advanced knowledge and skills in the dynamic fields of animation and gaming. This program is tailored to meet the demands of the industry and aims to develop professionals who can create visually stunning animations, design immersive gaming experiences, and explore cutting-edge technologies.
Throughout the program, students will gain a strong foundation in animation principles, storytelling techniques, character design, game development, and virtual reality. They will have access to state-of-the-art facilities and industry-standard software to bring their creative ideas to life. The program emphasizes hands-on learning, allowing students to work on real-world projects and build a portfolio that showcases their talents.
By the end of the program, graduates will be equipped with the necessary skills and knowledge to pursue successful careers in animation studios, gaming companies, advertising agencies, film production houses, and other related industries. They will have a deep understanding of industry trends, technological advancements, and the creative process involved in producing captivating animations and engaging games.
Enquire Now
Launch your career in Design with our M.Sc. Animation & Multimedia program. Experienced faculty, hands-on learning, and industry connections.
Course Information
Admission Procedure
Merit prepared on basis of the qualifying exam
Eligibility
Graduation from Animation & Gaming domain and any other branch of graduation with minimum 55% marks in graduation.
Important Links
Fee Structure
Scheme
Curriculum
Career Prospects
Graduates of the M.Sc. Animation & Multimedia program have a wide range of exciting career opportunities in the ever-growing field of animation and multimedia. Here are a few potential career paths for graduates:
Animation Artist/Animator: Graduates can work as animation artists or animators in animation studios, film production houses, advertising agencies, or gaming companies. They can create 2D and 3D animations, character animations, special effects, and motion graphics.
Game Designer/Developer: Graduates can pursue careers as game designers or developers, creating interactive and immersive gaming experiences. They can work on game concept development, level design, game mechanics, and gameplay programming.
Visual Effects Artist: Graduates can work as visual effects artists in the film and television industry. They can create stunning visual effects, such as explosions, magical effects, creature animations, and realistic environments.
Virtual Reality/Augmented Reality Developer: With the growing popularity of virtual reality (VR) and augmented reality (AR), graduates can specialize in creating VR/AR experiences, designing virtual environments, and developing interactive applications.
Multimedia Specialist: Graduates can work as multimedia specialists, creating interactive multimedia content for various platforms, including websites, mobile applications, educational software, and advertising campaigns.
Freelance Opportunities: Graduates can also choose to work as freelance animators, game developers, or visual effects artists, taking on independent projects, collaborating with clients, and building their portfolio.
Key Highlights
Comprehensive Curriculum: The program offers a comprehensive curriculum that covers various aspects of animation and gaming. It includes courses in 2D and 3D animation, game design and development, visual effects, virtual reality, and interactive media.
Industry-Relevant Skills: Students will acquire industry-relevant skills through hands-on projects, practical assignments, and workshops. They will work with industry-standard software and tools to develop their expertise and stay up to date with the latest trends.
Experienced Faculty: The faculty members bring their industry knowledge and expertise into the classroom, ensuring that students receive practical insights and guidance.
Industry Collaborations: Graphic Era Hill University has collaborations with leading companies, providing students with opportunities for internships, industry projects, and guest lectures by industry experts. These collaborations help students gain real-world exposure and build a strong professional network.
Career Guidance and Placement Support: The university provides career guidance and placement support to students, helping them explore career opportunities in various industries.
Research and Innovation: Students have the opportunity to engage in research and innovation projects, pushing the boundaries of animation and gaming. They can explore emerging technologies and develop new techniques to contribute to the field.
Frequently Asked Questions
Is prior experience in animation or multimedia necessary to enroll in the program?
While prior experience is beneficial, it is not mandatory. The program is designed to cater to students with various backgrounds. A passion for animation and multimedia, along with a willingness to learn and explore, is essential.
How does the program balance theory and practical learning?
The program aims to strike a balance between theoretical knowledge and practical application. Students will learn fundamental principles and theories related to animation and gaming, and they will also engage in hands-on projects, workshops, and industry simulations to apply their learning in practical scenarios.
Can I start my own animation or gaming studio after completing this program?
Yes, M.Sc. Animation & Multimedia program can provide you with the skills, knowledge, and creative foundation needed to start your own animation or gaming studio. With dedication, strategic planning, and a passion for innovation, you can turn your creative vision into a successful animation or gaming business.
Can I collaborate with fellow students on projects?
Collaboration is often encouraged in the M.Sc. Animation & Multimedia program. Students will have opportunities to work on group projects, collaborate on team assignments, and learn from each other’s diverse perspectives and skill sets.

title: MBA in Business Analytics - Graphic Era Hill University, Dehradun
content:
The MBA in Business Analytics at Graphic Era Hill University is a transformative two-year, full-time program designed to equip aspiring professionals with the critical skills needed to thrive in the data-driven business landscape. In an era where data is the new currency, this program focuses on building expertise in extracting actionable insights from vast datasets. Students will delve into the core principles of business analytics, learning how to leverage data to drive strategic decision-making, optimize operations, and enhance competitive advantage.
The curriculum is meticulously crafted to blend theoretical knowledge with practical application, ensuring graduates are industry-ready. The program emphasizes hands-on training in key areas such as Data Mining, Business Analytics, Predictive Modeling, and Data Visualization, using industry-standard tools like Python, R, Tableau, and Power BI. Students will learn to analyze historical data to solve complex strategic, tactical, and operational challenges, mastering cutting-edge analytical techniques. The program’s structure is designed to address the evolving needs of modern organizations, preparing students to navigate the complexities of big data and translate it into meaningful business outcomes. Through a combination of classroom learning, case studies, industry projects, and internships, students will gain a comprehensive understanding of how to apply business intelligence and analytics in a global context. The program also focuses on developing strong communication and presentation skills, enabling graduates to effectively convey data-driven insights to stakeholders.
Enquire Now
Launch your career in management with our MBA in Business Analytics program. Experienced faculty, hands-on learning, and industry connections.
Course Information
Admission Procedure
Aptitude Test & PI/self-introduction video. (Compulsory)
Note: *If Candidate has 75 Percentile in CAT/ MAT/ XAT/ CMAT or 210 score in NMAT, then the aptitude test is exempted

Eligibility

Important Links

Curriculum
Career Prospects
Graduates of the MBA in Business Analytics can pursue a diverse range of career opportunities across various industries. The demand for professionals who can analyze and interpret data effectively is rapidly increasing, making this program highly relevant and valuable. Potential career paths include:
Data Analyst
Business Analyst
Data Scientist
Financial Analyst
Database Administrator
Fraud Analyst
Consultant
IT Manager
Statistical Analyst
Key Highlights
Comprehensive Curriculum: The program covers a wide array of essential topics, including Data Mining, Business Analytics, Predictive Modeling, and Data Visualization, providing a holistic understanding of the analytics domain.
Hands-on Learning: Practical training is emphasized, with students gaining proficiency in industry-standard tools such as Python, R, Tableau, and Power BI, ensuring they are well-prepared for real-world scenarios.
Global Perspective: Students learn to apply business intelligence and analytics in a global business context, understanding the nuances of international markets and data-driven decision-making.
Industry Integration: Strong connections with leading businesses and organizations provide opportunities for internships and real-world project experience, bridging the gap between academia and industry.
Expert Faculty: The program is led by experienced professionals with extensive industry experience, providing students with valuable insights and mentorship.
Capstone Project: Students work on industry-sponsored projects, gaining real-time insights into business problems and developing practical solutions.
Industries to Explore
The scope of Business Analytics spans numerous industries, with companies across sectors recognizing the importance of data-driven decision-making. Graduates can explore opportunities in industries such as:
Technology and IT
Healthcare

E-commerce

Frequently Asked Questions
What is a BBA in Business Analytics?
A BBA in Business Analytics is an undergraduate program that combines business management education with data analysis, statistics, and technology. It prepares students to interpret data, generate insights, and support decision-making in various business domains.
What are the key subjects covered in this program?
The program typically includes subjects like business management, statistics, data analytics, financial management, marketing, operations, data visualization, machine learning basics, and use of analytical tools such as Excel, Python, and BI software.
What skills will I gain from this program?
Students develop analytical thinking, problem-solving, data interpretation, communication, teamwork, and technical skills. They also learn to use modern tools and technologies for analyzing and visualizing business data effectively.
What are the career opportunities after completing this program?
Graduates can work as business analysts, data analysts, marketing analysts, financial analysts, or consultants. Opportunities exist across industries such as banking, consulting, IT, e-commerce, and healthcare.
Is coding required in this program?
No, the program starts from foundational levels, so prior coding experience is not mandatory.
What is the eligibility criteria for admission?
Students typically need to have completed 10+2 (or equivalent) from a recognized board. Some institutions may require minimum percentage criteria or entrance exams.
How is this program different from a regular BBA?
Unlike a traditional BBA, this program focuses more on data-driven decision-making, analytics tools, and technology integration, making graduates more suitable for modern, data-centric business roles.
Are internships part of the program?
Yes, most programs include internships, live projects, or industry training. These provide practical exposure and help students apply their knowledge in real-world business scenarios.
What higher education options are available after this program?
Graduates can pursue MBA (Business Analytics, Finance, Marketing), MSc in Analytics, Data Science programs, or professional certifications like CFA, FRM, or specialized analytics courses.
Is Business Analytics a good career choice?
Yes, business analytics is a rapidly growing field due to increasing reliance on data for decision-making. It offers strong career prospects, competitive salaries, and opportunities across diverse industries globally.

title: MBA in Finance at Graphic Era Hill University, Dehradun
content:
The MBA in Finance Management at Graphic Era Hill University is a meticulously crafted, two-year postgraduate program designed to cultivate proficient finance professionals ready to navigate the complexities of the modern financial landscape. This program transcends traditional business education by providing a specialized focus on finance, equipping students with a robust foundation in financial theory and practical application. The curriculum is structured to foster critical thinking, analytical prowess, and strategic decision-making, essential attributes for success in the dynamic financial sector.
The program’s comprehensive curriculum covers a wide array of core financial areas. Students will gain in-depth knowledge of financial accounting principles, corporate finance strategies, investment analysis techniques, financial institutions and markets, and sophisticated risk management methodologies. A significant emphasis is placed on understanding behavioral finance, enabling students to recognize and analyze the psychological factors that influence financial decision-making. This holistic approach ensures graduates possess both theoretical knowledge and practical skills, preparing them to tackle real-world financial challenges effectively.
A distinguishing feature of this MBA program is the capstone project, a pivotal component designed to bridge the gap between academic learning and practical application. Students engage in real-life financial scenarios, applying their acquired knowledge to solve complex financial problems. This hands-on experience enhances their problem-solving abilities and prepares them for the demands of the industry. The program also integrates case studies, simulations, and industry interactions, providing students with a well-rounded and practical educational experience.

title: Dr. Purushottam Pantola | Faculty School of Agriculture - GEHU
content:
Dr. Purushottam Pantola Professor
RESEARCH AREA Horticulture vegetable production.
EDUCATION
Ph.D. (Horticulture),C.C.S. University Meerut, India (1995)
M.Sc.(Agriculture), C.C.S. University Meerut, India (1991)

AWARDS/HONORS
Best performer of DASP(World Bank Project) in Uttarakhand.
Implementation of more than 4 projects of the World bank.
Expert Member of NCOF (For organic certification).
Expert of Modern nursery technology for World Bank programmes.
Dr. Purushotam Pantola is a seasoned professional with experience in agriculture and rural development. Holding a Ph.D. in agriculture with a focus on horticulture. With an impressive career spanning 30+ years, Dr. Pantola has held key roles in various organizations. Notably, he worked as the Manager, Agribusiness, and Agriculture Expert for the Uttarakhand Decentralized Watershed Development Project from April 2008 to March 2018. In this capacity, he played a pivotal role in the development and management of market-linked farming systems, training project staff, and designing farmer-focused agribusiness training programs. Prior to this, he served as a division-level expert in agriculture and horticulture for PNGO Dwarahat and held roles such as Chief Coordinator in Grameen Evam Krishi Vikas Samiti, Haldwani. His responsibilities included coordinating DASP activities, promoting sustainable agriculture through organic farming, and providing technical guidance to field staff and farmers. Dr. Pantola’s expertise extends to consultancy work, where he contributed to the establishment of Root Trainer and Modern Nurseries for institutions like the Institute of Wood Science & Technology, Bangalore, the Kerala Forest Department, Trivandrum, and the Arid Forest Research Institute, Jodhpur. Beyond his professional endeavours, Dr. Pantola has actively participated in numerous training programs, seminars, and conferences, showcasing his commitment to continuous learning. His publications on various crops and technologies for farmers reflect his dedication to knowledge dissemination in the field of agriculture. Overall, Dr. Purushotam Pantola stands as a dynamic and accomplished professional, contributing significantly to the upliftment of rural areas and sustainable agriculture in the Himalayan region. He has more than fifty news for training programme in different News Paper and has published fourth nightly newspaper named Agrocoop Audhyaniky. Additionaly, he has printed pamphlets in different crops/technologies for farmers/SHGs on Vermi Composting, NADEP, Polytunnel/Polyhouse technology, Low Cost Polyhouse, B.D. Heap, EM Techniques, Cow Pet Pit (CPP), Aonla Cultivation, Ginger Cultivation, Scientific Cultivation of Tomato/Jack Fruit/ Pea/ Potato/ Cabbage/ Cauliflower/Straw berry, IPM/IPNM in vegetables crop.

What is the duration of the M.B.A Business Analytics program?

title: RAWE 2024 – Dehradun Bridging Theory and Practice in Agriculture - Graphic Era Hill University, Dehradun
content:
On August 20, 2024, Graphic Era Hill University launched the Rural Agricultural Work Experience (RAWE) program for the B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture Batch of 2021-2025, with an orientation session marking the beginning of this vital component of their degree. Dr. Neelam Basera, RAWE Coordinator, delivered an inspiring inaugural speech, emphasizing the importance of integrating classroom learning with real-world field experiences. Dr. Basera urged students to embrace the opportunities provided by the RAWE program to gain practical insights into rural agricultural practices. The session continued with guidance from Dr. Arvind Singh Negi, Head of the Department, who outlined the course structure and underscored the significance of a sincere approach to learning. This year's RAWE orientation underscores Graphic Era’s commitment to providing students with invaluable practical exposure across its campuses in Bhimtal, Haldwani, and Dehradun.
Along with this final-year B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture students embarked on an insightful village attachment as part of the Rural Agriculture Work Experience (RAWE) program at Banjarawala village. Guided by Dr. Neelam Basera (RAWE Coordinator), Dr. Manpreet Singh, and Dr. Kumar Gaurav (Unit Heads), the students actively engaged with Gram Pradhan Mr. Mukesh Saini and local villagers, fostering a collaborative environment for learning.
Through transect walks and rapport-building exercises, students gained invaluable insights into the intricacies of rural life and village dynamics. This hands-on experience allowed them to connect theoretical knowledge with real-world challenges, emphasizing the importance of understanding community practices in agriculture. title: Scholarships - Graphic Era Hill University, Haldwani
content:
The University introduces handsome scholarships Year on Year, which often have proven to be the trend setters for private Universities in India. This document provides clarity on the Types of Scholarships and Waivers that students have the possibility of availing depending on their candidatures
Types of Scholarships
Academic Scholarship
The Fee Structure at Graphic Era , clearly mentions the Academic Scholarships provided in all courses defined in various categories based on the merit of the candidate obtained in the qualifying examination considered for admission into that specific course.
The Academic Scholarships provided in the Fee Structure has been defined for the entire course duration. The Scholarship bracket availed by the candidate at the time of the admission is frozen for the entire duration of the course. There is no change in the scholarship amount during the course, however the candidate will have to score a minimum aggregate of 7 SGPA, in order for the scholarship to applied in each semester. For candidates who fail to score 7 SGPA or above in any of the semesters, the scholarship will not be applicable for that particular semester. If the candidate is able to score 7 SGPA or above in the subsequent semester(s), the scholarship will be reinstated. In addition to the aforementioned 7 SGPA clause, the same terms are applicable on the student obtaining a backlog (failing to pass a subject) in a semester. If the student scores 7 SGPA or above but has still scored a backlog in a subject, the scholarship for that semester will be discontinued.
The fee structure clearly mentions the amount of the Academic Scholarship available to candidates or the entire course duration. This amount remains fixed for the entire course duration.
There are a number of other scholarships/concessions that the candidates might be eligible for – please do not confuse this with the Academic Scholarship – the amounts for this are mentioned clearly under the head “Academic Scholarship” in the Fee Structures corresponding to all courses.
Fee Concession For Female Candidates (10% On Net Tuition Fee)
An integral part of our Scholarship structure is the vision to empower females in various disciplines across the country, and as a part of this effort, Graphic Era has been running a special scholarship scheme for all Female Candidates in the University
An additional 10% Scholarship is provided to all female candidates (across all courses) on the Net Tuition Fee. This Scholarship is termed additional, as it will be applicable to candidates regardless of whether they are availing Academic Scholarship or not.
Fee Concession For Wards Of Defence Personnel (5% On Net Tuition Fee)
Graphic Era has a rich legacy of respecting the service of the Personnel of the brave defence forces of India, and as a no questions asked benefit being passed on to the community, the University has a blanket Fee Concession of 5% on the Net Tuition Fee for all candidates who are wards of Defence Personnel.
This category covers Current and Ex-Servicemen from the Indian Armed Forces (Indian Army, Indian Air Force, Indian Navy and all Paramilitary Forces) across all levels.
The candidate will be required to provide proof of employment for their parent(s) in the categories mentioned above.
Loyalty Concession: 10% (On Net Tuition Fee)
Graphic Era values it’s Alumni, and wishes to assist them in attaining Higher Education to the extent that they aspire to. In order to ease out the process of attaining degrees higher than graduation, the University provides a Loyalty Concession of 10% on the Net Tuition Fee for all candidates who have attained a UG Degree from any of the institutions falling under the purview of Graphic Era Group of Institutions.
The difference between Year of Passing out and the Year of enrolling in a PG Course bear no importance in this concession. Any and every one falling into the aforementioned criterion will be provided this benefit.
Sibling Concession: (7.5% - Current Student and 5% - Alumni on NET TUITION FEE)
The University, its students and its Alumni are one big family and with this clear understanding, we aspire to provide financial assistance to candidates who are immediate siblings of a current student of Graphic Era or an Alumni of any of the institutions under Graphic Era Group of Institutions.
There are two sub-categories of concessions in this category:
Current Student: Immediate Siblings of a student who is currently a student of Graphic Era will be eligible for a Fee Concession of 7.5% on the NET TUITION FEE.
Alumni: Immediate Siblings of a student who is an Alumni of Graphic Era, will be eligible for a Fee Concession of 5% on the NET TUITION FEE.
IMPORTANT CONDITIONS: 1. The concession is applicable only for immediate siblings and not for cousins or any other distant sibling relation. 2. If two candidates (real siblings) are seeking admission at the same time, with no sibling already studying at Graphic Era or passed out from Graphic Era, only one of the two students will be eligible for the Sibling Concession (7.5%) – which of the two candidates wishes to receive the Concession is up to the candidate and their family. 3. If the status of the a current student of Graphic Era, who’s sibling has just taken admission at the University, changes from Current Student to Alumni, during the course of the younger sibling – the concession will be revised from 7.5% to 5% as soon as the elder sibling passes out of the University
Download Full Scholarship Policy Graphic Era University 2023 Policy
Policy For The Application Of The Scholarships/concessions
Since there are a number of scholarships that a candidate may be eligible for, there is a formal rule that defines the maximum number of scholarships a candidate may avail. The rule is defined as below, along with a use case that clarifies all scenarios:
Mandatory Scholarship (For Candidates eligible as per the different criterions defined in the corresponding section) –
ACADEMIC SCHOLARSHIP
All other scholarships are additional scholarships that are added on top of the Academic Scholarship. As a formal rule, a maximum of 3 Scholarships/Concessions can be availed by a candidate in addition to the Academic Scholarship (Academic Scholarship + 3 Additional Scholarships/Concessions). These scholarships are applied in descending order, in order to provide the maximum benefit to the candidate.
USE CASE for clear understanding:
Candidate A is seeking admission at Graphic Era – He is eligible for ACADEMIC SCHOLARSHIP, Female Candidate Scholarship, Ward of Defence Personnel, Loyalty Concession and Sibling Concession (7.5%). The order of the Scholarship/Concession granted will be as below:
Academic Scholarship → Female Candidate (10%) → Loyalty Concession (10%) → Sibling Concession (7.5%)
So, as per the rule – Academic Scholarship + 3 – the aforementioned discounts were provided – Defence Scholarship wasn’t included as it carries a lower value (5%) as compared to the other concessions that the candidate was eligible for, and since there are only a maximum of 3 Scholarships that can be applied on top of the Academic Scholarship, the aforementioned scenario was the one that provided the highest concession possible.
IMPORTANT NOTE:
An additional 5% Concession on Net Tuition Fee is applicable for candidates who choose to pay their Course Fees in Annual Mode i.e. Depositing their Course Fee for an entire year together. This concession is only applicable to yearly payment mode and candidates paying their fees in half-yearly mode will not be provided any concession.
It is important to note that this concession is applied after all of the above scholarships have been calculated – this is not a part of the Mandatory Scholarships + 3 rule.
All scholarships are provided on the condition of the candidates providing valid documents concerning the criterion. Failure to provide the same will result in immediate cancellation of the scholarship allotted, and in cases of fake documentation provided – the candidate will be liable to have his/her admission cancelled, in addition to recovery of dues and legal proceedings that may follow.

A diploma program is usually shorter and focuses more on practical skills and hands-on training.
